description: Frontend Interview Setup Page - Create the interview configuration page where students select job role, interview type, difficulty, resume, and question count, then trigger interview creation and AI question generation. Includes loading states during async operations.
steps: Create frontend/src/app/interview/setup/page.tsx as a 'use client' component
Import: useState, useEffect from react, useRouter from next/navigation, api from @/lib/api, Navbar from @/components/layout/Navbar, icons from lucide-react (Briefcase, FileText, Zap, Play)
State: jobRoles (array), resumes (array), loading (boolean), submitting (boolean), error (string), formData { jobRoleId, interviewType, difficulty, resumeId, questionCount }
useEffect on mount: fetch GET /job-roles and set jobRoles, fetch GET /resumes and filter for isActive=true and set resumes, handle errors with setError

Form fields: jobRoleId select (map jobRoles to options), interviewType radio buttons (HR/TECHNICAL/PROJECT with icons and descriptions), difficulty radio buttons (EASY/MEDIUM/HARD with color-coded badges), resumeId select (map resumes, show fileName, mark optional), questionCount number input (min=5, max=15, default=10, step=1)
Validation: jobRoleId required (disable submit if empty), show warning if resumeId not selected: 'Interviews work best with a resume. Upload one in your profile.'

onSubmit handler: setSubmitting(true), POST /interviews with formData, on success immediately POST /interviews/:id/start, show loading text 'Generating AI questions...', on start success router.push(/interview/${id}), on error display error.response.data.message, setSubmitting(false)
Loading states: show skeleton loaders while fetching job roles/resumes, disable entire form while submitting, show spinner on submit button
Styling: match dashboard page aesthetic (gradient headers, white cards with rounded borders, indigo accent colors, responsive grid), use Tailwind classes
Layout: wrap in <Navbar /> + main with max-w-4xl centered container
acceptance_criteria: Setup page renders with all form fields
Job roles and resumes load from API on mount
Form validation prevents submission without required fields
Submitting shows loading state with 'Generating AI questions...' message
Error messages display clearly without crashing the page
Page matches dashboard styling and is fully responsive
verification: cd frontend && npm install — completes without errors
cd frontend && npm run dev — starts on port 3000
Verify job roles dropdown populates with 10 roles
Verify resumes dropdown shows active resumes (or empty if none)
Select all fields and click 'Start Interview'
Verify loading spinner appears with 'Generating AI questions...' text
Test error case: stop backend, submit form, verify error message displays
